brief:
Displaced families in Gaza confront mounting health risks after spending months in camps positioned adjacent to waste sites, the Palestine News Network reported. Shorouq Saadallah and her family have lived in a displacement camp near a garbage dump for the past eight months, where accumulating refuse, flies, and other hazards present daily threats to residents' physical wellbeing and sanitation.

The placement of displacement shelters in proximity to refuse sites has intensified the humanitarian emergency facing those forced from their homes. Vulnerable populations living in these camps face exposure to contamination, disease vectors, and deteriorating conditions that compound the challenges of displacement itself.

title: Displacement camps near Gaza garbage dumps create severe health hazards
